title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: switch bill availability, limit and fee by document type
content:
## Scope

A switch bill is issued in exchange for an existing document. This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents quick reference states, for the document being exchanged, whether a switch bill may be issued in exchange for it, the maximum number of switch bills issued for one booking, and the fee per switch bill, which is charged on the document exchanged.

## Tier table

| Document type exchanged | Switch bill may be issued in exchange | Maximum switch bills per booking | Fee per switch bill (charged on the document exchanged) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | 0 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | 0 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | No | 0 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | 1 | USD 185.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | 1 | USD 210.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | 0 | USD 0.00 |

## Questions answered by the table

**Which documents can be exchanged for a switch bill?** Only the AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading and the AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading.

**How many switch bills may one booking have on those types?** At most 1.

**Which document carries the switch fee?** The document exchanged: USD 185.00 when it is an AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading, USD 210.00 when it is an AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading.

**Can an AHL Switch Bill of Lading itself be exchanged for another switch bill?** Its own setting is No, with a limit of 0.
